decisions.reason: As an incremental extension of the established radiant-heating line, it is cheap to keep available and there is no evidence yet that market feedback has resolved its value negatively.
The electric infrared panel heater fits the firm's broad customized offer and the shift toward lower-carbon heating, so under ongoing uncertainty it is worth keeping the option open.
The electric halogen infrared heater gives the firm another related technology option for different non-residential use cases, and with no clear failure signal abandonment would be premature.

This product is close to the core hall-heating business, likely leverages existing engineering and service capabilities, and the expanding firm can justify keeping it on the market while demand becomes clearer.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater directly supports the firm's strategic move toward hydrogen-ready systems and already had an early real-world deployment, so its upside warrants continued market presence.
